fit_reason: Whole vehicle, a 1984 Grumman step van food truck, listed by a private owner in cars by owner. It needs mechanical work, but the body and interior can still be detailed.
findings: Dull, streaky and blotchy finish across the bare aluminum body panels on the passenger side
Grime and scuff marks on the diamond-plate floor down the kitchen aisle
Clutter in the kitchen area, including a plastic bag, a crate and loose items on the counters
Smudged, dull stainless surfaces on the back wall and around the hood area
Dirty cab steps and a cluttered driver area seen through the open door
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Grumman step van food truck. The kitchen floor and stainless surfaces look like they could use a deep clean, and the aluminum body panels look dull and streaky. We do pre-sale details and metal polishing that come to you, so the truck can sit where it is. Would you like a quote?
